set.body: Roadmap P3 first direct computational route. Input-bound recorded proposals over anchored source/recall units and existing detail occurrences; preserve narrative versus referent, single/joint/broad/alternative/external and processing statuses. Conditional fidelity cites exact source evidence within each hypothesis; no overwrite of existing bindings or silent reference-to-fidelity implication. Provide unit-only/order-independent prompt inputs with audit: no neighboring recall or global recall position leak. Offline record-before-parse/replay, API/CLI and three-view consumption. Reuse current working Scala mapper/claim assessment contracts and original receipts where permitted; no live/paid provider or private text. First current row/scene targets are bounded; event/episode targets and richer matching remain explicit P3 obligations.
set.title: P3.1 Resolve recorded direct reference and conditional fidelity without a graph prerequisite
